# Fairstay Payroll Accruals (`fairstay-payroll-accruals`)

Payroll and PTO accruals at month end for nursing homes: wages earned but not paid by department, employer taxes, PTO liability, the difference from what is booked, and journal entry lines a person posts. Employee names and ids are masked before results reach the model.

**Fairstay Payroll Accruals never posts journal entries.**

Fairstay ver 1 · Payroll and staffing · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`fairstay-core`](../fairstay-core)

```bash
npx -y fairstay-payroll-accruals demo
npx -y fairstay-payroll-accruals mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Cedar Hollow payroll accruals for March 2026, with employer taxes of 8.5% and a tolerance of 100. Planted:

- Nursing: the 15 to 28 March period is paid 3 April, so all of it is accrued. The 29 March to 11 April period is 3 of 14 days in March. Together that is 7378 with taxes, against 6100 booked.
- Dietary: the 1 to 14 March period was paid 20 March, so only the late-March share is accrued.
- Housekeeping: PTO liability is 1519 with taxes, against 900 booked.

Employee names and ids are in [`phi-canaries.json`](fixtures/phi-canaries.json); they must never reach the model. [`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) misspells a setting, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `accruals_check` | Calculate wage and PTO accruals by department and compare them with what is booked. | runs |
| `accruals_write_report` | Write accruals.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and accruals.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/accruals). | runs |
| `accruals_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `accruals_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `accruals_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `accruals_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `journal_post` | Fairstay Payroll Accruals never posts journal entries. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `accruals_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `register` (required) | Payroll register for the pay periods around month end under --root: employee, department, period start and end, pay date, gross |
| `pto` | PTO balances at month end under --root: employee, department, hours, hourly rate |
| `booked` | Accruals already booked under --root: department, kind (wages or PTO), amount |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: employer_tax_pct, tolerance, pto_taxed |
| `month` (required) | Month to check, YYYY-MM |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx fairstay-payroll-accruals inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Payroll register (`register`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, File Number |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name |
| `department` | text | Department, Dept, Cost Center, Home Department |
| `period_start` (required) | date | Period Start, Pay Period Start, Begin |
| `period_end` (required) | date | Period End, Pay Period End, End |
| `pay_date` | date | Pay Date, Check Date |
| `gross` (required) | amount | Gross, Gross Pay, Total Earnings |

### PTO balances (`pto`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, File Number |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name |
| `department` | text | Department, Dept, Cost Center, Home Department |
| `hours` (required) | number | Hours, PTO Hours, Balance Hours, Available Hours |
| `rate` (required) | amount | Rate, Hourly Rate, Pay Rate |

### Booked accruals (`booked`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `department` | text | Department, Dept, Cost Center, Home Department |
| `kind` | text | Kind, Type, Accrual, Account Name |
| `amount` (required) | amount | Amount, Amt, Total, Balance, Net Amount, Payment Amount, Paid, Paid Amount |

## Settings file (`accruals_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `employer_tax_pct` | Employer payroll taxes as a percent of wages (FICA 7.65 plus unemployment; default 8.5) |
| `tolerance` | Differences up to this amount are left alone (default 500) |
| `pto_taxed` | Add employer taxes to the PTO liability (default true) |

## Memory

`accruals_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `accruals_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `accrual_note` | is shown with results. It never changes the numbers. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `fairstay-core` and `fairclaim-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fairstay-payroll-accruals": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "fairstay-payroll-accruals",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add fairstay-payroll-accruals -- npx -y fairstay-payroll-accruals mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
fairstay-payroll-accruals tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
fairstay-payroll-accruals sources               # the columns each input is read from
fairstay-payroll-accruals inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
fairstay-payroll-accruals call accruals_check '{"register":"<register>","month":"<month>"}'
fairstay-payroll-accruals eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
fairstay-payroll-accruals demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
